evaluation_difference.proof:
by
  intro F inst p q x
  exact Polynomial.eval_sub p q x
evaluation_difference.refutation:
by
  letI : Fact (1 < 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  intro h
  have bad := h 0 1 0
  norm_num at bad
  exact (by decide : (-1 : ZMod 5) ≠ 1) bad

difference_nonzero.proof:
by
  intro F inst p q hne
  exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hne
difference_nonzero.refutation:
by
  letI : Fact (1 < 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  intro h
  exact h 0 0 (by simp)

sample_root_bound.proof:
by
  intro F inst r S hne hroots
  apply Polynomial.card_le_degree_of_subset_roots
  intro x hx
  exact (Polynomial.mem_roots hne).mpr (hroots x hx)
sample_root_bound.refutation:
by
  letI : Fact (1 < 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  intro h
  have bad := h 0 {0} (by simp [Polynomial.IsRoot])
  simp at bad

difference_degree.proof:
by
  intro F inst p q
  exact Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le p q
difference_degree.refutation:
by
  letI : Fact (1 < 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  intro h
  have bad := h Polynomial.X 0
  simp at bad

agreement_is_root.refutation:
by
  letI : Fact (1 < 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  intro h
  have bad := h 1 1 0 rfl
  norm_num [Polynomial.IsRoot] at bad
  exact (by decide : (2 : ZMod 5) ≠ 0) bad
agreement_is_root.proof:
by
  intro F inst p q x h
  simp [Polynomial.IsRoot, h]

evaluation_unique.proof:
by
  intro F inst p q S hagrees hdegree
  exact Polynomial.eq_of_natDegree_lt_card_of_eval_eq' p q S hagrees hdegree
evaluation_unique.refutation:
by
  letI : Fact (1 < 5) := ⟨by decide⟩
  intro h
  have bad := h Polynomial.X 0 {0} (by simp) (by simp)
  exact Polynomial.X_ne_zero bad
